description: This Java class 'HtmlWidgetRenderer' provides methods for rendering HTML widgets, including boundary comments, named borders, whitespace appending, and AJAX parameter extraction. It serves as a base class for other widget HTML rendering classes within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: HtmlWidgetRenderer
classes.description: A base class for rendering HTML widgets with support for boundary comments, named borders, whitespace, and AJAX parameter extraction.

methods.name: setWidgetCommentsEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the rendering of boundary comments around widgets.

methods.name: isWidgetCommentsEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether widget boundary comments are enabled.

methods.name: appendWhitespace
methods.description: Appends whitespace characters to the provided writer.

methods.name: buildBoundaryComment
methods.description: Builds an HTML comment string indicating the start or end of a widget boundary.

methods.name: beginNamedBorder
methods.description: Generates HTML for the beginning of a named border, depending on configuration and theme paths.

methods.name: endNamedBorder
methods.description: Generates HTML to close a named border if applicable.

methods.name: formatBoundaryJsComment
methods.description: Creates a JavaScript comment string for widget boundaries.

methods.name: renderBeginningBoundaryComment
methods.description: Renders the beginning boundary comment if enabled.

methods.name: renderEndingBoundaryComment
methods.description: Renders the ending boundary comment if enabled.

methods.name: getAjaxParamsFromTarget
methods.description: Extracts and formats query parameters from a URL for AJAX calls.
